title: 中金刁智海：选举不确定性落地，明年业务上行空间有多大？
speaker: Diao Jihai

segments.en: at all? I mean, we talked about the tax crackdown here in Hong Kong. Have you seen any sort of effect from your clients, whether it's the types of products that they're looking at? I mean the flows
segments.zh: 我们谈过香港的税务打击，您的客户是否受到影响，比如他们关注的产品类型？资金流动

segments.en: has anything kind of slowed down? You think since this crackdown started about six months ago?
segments.zh: 是否有放缓？您认为自六个月前打击开始以来？

segments.en: I think this first half is really strong, right? Yeah. So maybe the uncertainty is
segments.zh: 我认为上半年非常强劲，对吧？所以不确定性可能

segments.en: around us just in the past two months and you can see the election, right? The midterm election, but now I think most of the uncertainty is already had the answer. So I think lower the uncertainty
segments.zh: 就在过去两个月围绕我们，您能看到选举，中期选举，但现在我认为大部分不确定性已有答案。所以降低不确定性

segments.en: will help to the market and also to our client to make the decision next step.
segments.zh: 将有助于市场和我们的客户做出下一步决定。

segments.en: is great and I think our philosophy for our business also can help the client in China and Hong
segments.zh: 很大，而且我认为我们的业务理念也能帮助中国和香港的客户。

segments.en: Kong. You just opened a branch in Dubai not too long ago as well. I mean, given what we're seeing
